source_proof.claim: Local service checks nonzero MaxTotalSize before accounting, filename assignment, write queue, create or append. Every service starts at total zero. With each reachable blob greater than one byte, no write passes the first check and total remains zero; no accumulation or overflow is introduced. Zero cap would disable the limit and is not used.

The inherited C31 proof covers both channel serializers including compression inside the mandatory outer envelope: V2 >=36 bytes; legacy V1 >=20 bytes (28 on this64-bit target). Local service does not apply a second codec after checking size.

Node mask None disables mask-controlled GraceJoin, WideSort and generic aggregation spill variants. New hash aggregation still may spill: both state and input use the scalar wide adapter, including scalarized block types. Nonempty packed batches contain length and row-count metadata of at least one byte each; empty adapters never Put. Optional/empty values cannot remove these fields.

Additional hybrid hash joins are not disabled by the node mask. Both block and scalar variants use THybridHashJoin and obtain a spiller from the context. Their only typed payloads are packed pages and probe-match bitmaps. A page includes mandatory i64 NTuples (8 bytes) before payload; empty pages reject. A bitmap serializes a vector whose size prefix is ui32 (at least4 bytes), even for an empty bitmap. Type, null, zero-width payload and compression cannot remove those headers. Thus required block behavior remains enabled and protected.

All one/four nodes get the supplied AppConfig. SetupProxies is called per node and passes the same TableServiceConfig; each proxy creates a node-local spill service with its configured MaxTotalSize. Remote channels therefore do not escape to an unbounded default service.

Query/channel sharing eligibility depends on query-service spilling plus global service capability, not the compute-node mask. Service remains enabled, so the global flag and shared-stage admission are preserved.

optimization_under_test_assessment.Q03_Q04_Q06_Q07_Q17_Q23_Q24_Q29: Lookup/range/cost/liveness optimizations precede the late node mask. Existing hints, auto-index settings, distributed node counts and both special Q07 block-format controls remain unchanged.

optimization_under_test_assessment.Q14: All six block/shuffle-direction controls preserve UseBlockHashJoin=true, DqHashOperatorsUseBlocks=false, exact shuffle directives and four nodes. Disabling block joins would invalidate these controls and is not proposed.
optimization_under_test_assessment.Q15: The one after-aggregate control preserves shuffle-elimination/partition metadata and physical aggregate modes. Node-mask change happens after those decisions.
optimization_under_test_assessment.Q21: Dependent-domain aggregation and rewrite selection remain unchanged, with their channel-sharing requirement enabled.
optimization_under_test_assessment.Q28: The SQL shared control keeps the actual shared route and scheduling inputs. This does not expand the separate seven-case SDK compilation pilot or its admission.
